title: Meridian upgrade integration qualification register
description: Container for the final, product-neutral qualification (record_type: upgrade-integration-qualification) of one workspace's run through packages 1-8 of the meridian-operating-upgrade program (meridian-operating-foundation, task-pattern-registry, task-specification-contract, execution-state-model, role-and-human-control, bounded-context-manifest, evidence-and-handoff-contract, meridian-field-evaluation). This is the ninth, penultimate package: it does not classify a task, run a task, resolve a norm, manage context, record evidence, hand off a result or observe a metric itself - it only QUALIFIES already-composed records produced by those eight packages, exactly the way workspace-compatibility-qualification.schema.json qualifies the meridian-workspace-compatibility program without duplicating any of its five composed contracts. payload.task_journey_ref is a CLOSED pinned reference to one FULL evidence-and-handoff record (record_type evidence-and-handoff), resolved through an external boundary at the library level and checked there against the REAL evaluateEvidenceAndHandoff - never a second, competing shape. A resolved evidence-and-handoff record already composes execution-state-model, role-and-human-control, bounded-context-manifest and, transitively, task-specification-contract and task-pattern-registry (evidence-and-handoff-contract.md SS4, SS12), so this is the single terminal composition point for packages 2-7; this schema does not resolve those four packages a second time. payload.field_evaluation_report_ref is a CLOSED pinned reference to one FULL field-evaluation-report record (package 8), or null when no report has been composed yet - field-evaluation-report carries eight separate characteristics with NO collapse into one score (meridian-field-evaluation.md SS3), so it is composed as its own terminal reference, never folded into task_journey_ref's verdict. payload.scenario_classifications is a CLOSED, exactly-three-element array, one entry per required neutral scenario (single-module-refactor, multi-repository-decomposition, language-change-limit-case - upgrade-integration-qualification.md SS4), each pinning a FULL task-specification record and a FULL execution-run record, both resolved through an external boundary and checked against the REAL evaluateTaskSpecification/evaluateExecutionState. payload.workspace_transition_compatibility is a required, closed, product-neutral template requirement recording that a compatibility record for the Kernel/Instance transition to the new operating-model workspace model exists as a Kernel-side template (status is closed to the single legal value "kernel-template-only" in this Kernel slice) - it never carries any product-specific evidence, which is the subject of a separate, later Instance package. payload.qualification_state is a closed, RECOMPUTED verdict - QUALIFIED, BLOCKED or UNVERIFIED - checked at the library level against the composed evaluations' own outcome; a declared state that does not match the recomputed one is rejected, never trusted on its own. blockers/open_questions are closed to qualification_state: blockers is non-empty exactly when BLOCKED, open_questions is non-empty exactly when UNVERIFIED. This package does not classify, run, resolve, manage context, record evidence, hand off, or observe metrics for any actual product; it only qualifies - declares one closed verdict over records produced by the eight packages it composes. The contract is a mandatory part of the Kernel: an absent schema or absent fixtures is a validator FAIL, not an informational skip. The normative document is standards/workspace/upgrade-integration-qualification.md.

pinned_ref.description: A closed reference resolved through an external boundary - never an embedded body. sha256 is mandatory: the exact composed version's own recomputed content digest (computeContentDigest), never a bare id/reference an independent resolver could satisfy with different content under the same label.

workspace_transition_compatibility.description: A product-neutral Kernel template requirement, not a filled Instance record. status is closed to "kernel-template-only" in this Kernel slice: the actual Kernel/Instance transition evidence for a real product's workspace model is the subject of a separate, later Instance package and is never written here.

task_journey_ref.description: Always required: a qualification without a pinned, resolvable evidence-and-handoff record (the terminal composition point of packages 2-7) does not exist.

field_evaluation_report_ref.description: null when no field-evaluation-report has been composed yet for this task journey; otherwise a pinned reference to one FULL field-evaluation-report entry (package 8), sha256-pinned to its recomputed content digest.

scenario_classifications.description: Exactly three entries, one per required neutral scenario (single-module-refactor, multi-repository-decomposition, language-change-limit-case) - checked at the library level for exact scenario_id coverage (no gap, no duplicate, no extra) and for each entry's task_specification_ref/execution_state_ref resolving, sha256-matching and classifying as that scenario requires.
